notes: The renewal is the interesting mechanic: there is no published monthly ceiling, only a per-session ceiling that a user may renew, which makes it a perpetual free lane rather than a trial. Two limits make it a demo lane: one free instance per user, and the 72-hour release that deletes the working files. The identity door is the open item: CodeLab is only available in the Beijing region and a mainland Huawei Cloud account carries a real-name check, which is the reason for the fails-identity verdict, but I read no Huawei page that states the real-name requirement for CodeLab itself, so that specific claim is reported rather than documented.
